referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This data set includes the basic structure of the kitchen cupboards (melamin coated particle board) and the front cover (melamin coated) per m3. The inventory bases on a kitchen with a cupboard volume of 3.36 m3. Screws and hinges are considered proportionally. The countertop, sink, waste system and cooker hood are not included.; Geography: Data valid for Switzerland
